text: Total exports increase year over year while shipments to China and the United States decline. Export volumes rise toward Southeast Asia, Hong Kong, and Western Europe, with semiconductor exports increasing sharply. Import growth exceeds expectations while trade distribution shifts across regional partners.

meta.note: Directional reversal across major partners required inversion over aggregate growth dominance.

text: Producer price index rises 0.7% monthly and 3.4% annually, exceeding forecasts. Services and goods costs both increase, with notable gains in food, energy, and financial service categories. Treasury yields rise and rate-cut expectations shift while inflation measures remain above target ranges.

meta.note: Market reaction and price data coexist; compression prioritized due to persistent elevated inflation band.
